info.title: PKSE
info.author: Kiasta
info.details:
PKSE (Pokémon Save Editor) is a Pokémon save editor for Nintendo Switch consoles -- no PC or save transfers needed.

Supported games:
- FireRed/LeafGreen
- Let's Go, Pikachu!/Eevee!
- Sword/Shield
- Brilliant Diamond/Shining Pearl
- Legends: Arceus
- Scarlet/Violet
- Legends: Z-A

Features:
- Edit party and box Pokémon: species, level, IVs/EVs, nature, ability, moves, held item, ball, OT and met data, shininess and gender
- Trainer info and item pouches, with per-game item and count limits
- Pokémon creator -- build one from scratch in any supported game's format
- Legality checker flags illegal values as you edit; it never blocks or alters your data
- Cross-game bank: deposit from one game, withdraw into another, converted to the destination format with origin preserved
- HOME-style interface with full touch support
- On-console save backup and restore with retained history

Free, open source, built using PKHeX as a reference.

changelog:
Version 1.0 Release
This release brings several new features, title support, a whole new UI interface and a plethora of bug fixes.  

Newly supported titles:
- FireRed/LeafGreen
- Let's Go, Pikachu!/Eevee!
- Brilliant Diamond/Shining Pearl
- Legends: Arceus
- Scarlet/Violet

Editing:
- Party & box Pokémon: species, level, stats, IVs/EVs (AVs in Let's Go),
    nature, ability, moves, held item, ball, OT/met/origin, shininess and gender. Ribbons are still read-only.
- Trainer info and item pouches, with per-game item and count limits.
- Pokémon creator: build one from scratch in any game's format, with legal
    values highlighted.
- Legality checker: flags illegal values as you edit (informational; it never
    blocks or changes anything). Legality still a WIP.
- Cross-game bank: PKSE-native storage every supported game shares. A Pokémon
    deposited from one game is converted into the destination's format on
    withdrawal, preserving its origin (OT, IDs, met data, IVs, nature, PID).

Interface & save handling:
- HOME-style UI (NanoVG) with better 256px HD sprites, full touch controls, and
    scrollable storage and lists.
- On-console backup and restore, with retained backup history.
- Per-game save-version and DLC detection.
- On-screen error reporting (including when no backups are present).
